# Synthetic

## Synthetic Attributes

Describes telemetry generated by synthetic sources such as tests or bots.

**Attributes:**

| Key | Stability | Value Type | Description | Example Values |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <a id="synthetic-type" href="#synthetic-type">`synthetic.type`</a> | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | string | Specifies the category of synthetic traffic, such as tests or bots. [1] | `bot`; `test` |

**[1] `synthetic.type`:** Components that populate the attribute are responsible for determining what they consider to be synthetic bot or test traffic. This attribute can either be set for self-identification purposes, or on telemetry detected to be generated as a result of a synthetic request. This attribute is useful for distinguishing between genuine client traffic and synthetic traffic generated by bots or tests.

The attribute is not limited to a specific protocol: it applies to any telemetry that is known to originate from a synthetic source, including telemetry that is produced downstream of the synthetic request. For HTTP, this attribute MAY be derived from the contents of the `user_agent.original` attribute.

---

`synthetic.type` has the following list of well-known values. If one of them applies, then the respective value MUST be used; otherwise, a custom value MAY be used.

| Value | Description | Stability |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bot` | Bot source. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `test` | Synthetic test source. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
